title: Global Event: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) Live Activity Report
content_md: GreyNoise is monitoring scanning and exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-114938, also known as “Java4Shell,” a memory-corruption vulnerability in OpenJDK’s Base64 decoder. Article Link: Global Event: Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) Live Activity Report

CVE-2026-114938.evidence: GreyNoise reports scanning and exploitation attempts against CVE-2026-114938, without confirming successful compromise.
